rationale: bugs_open/363 phase 1 moved four Go guards off the text of append-only migration files and onto platform/livespec, a declaration allowed to change. plan.risks: The five new declarations are read by the deployed auditor only after the next whole-fleet release, so they cannot turn today's 07:00 CronJob red; when they do ship the probed count rises from 5 to 10. Each was verified against the live database before submission, and the page-build-handler probe was run with a disconfirming control. The probe deliberately uses the #>> exact-path operator rather than jsonb_path_exists, because a bare ? in SQL handed to a Go driver can be read as a bind placeholder. This commit deliberately does NOT add the required_fields_missing entry that bugs_open/375 needs: its own CONTRIB states that registering it fails three arms of CQ-023's router and that arming close_converted fail-closes a live route, so that sequencing belongs to 375. It also does not touch the live claimed-item-timeout pre_query, owned by active lanes 341 and 307. The residual this change does not close is recorded in the code: the live pre_query's own prose still describes a superseded contract and names a deleted test, and a values-comparison auditor passes it because the clause matches while the prose lies.
